eplb_moe_placement.description: MoE expert-parallel load balancing on the paper's ShareGPT/GSM8K expert-load trace (288 replicas, 8 expert groups, 4 nodes, 32 GPUs): rebalance on a 100-step window, keep GPU load balanced on the next window, and do it with less rebalance work than the frontier-lab reference.
eplb_moe_placement._scale_note: Paper values are kept as reported. The paper measures wall-clock rebalance time (540 / 19.6 / 3.7 ms); the gym measures rebalance work as retired CPU instructions of the policy process (hardware counter read by the evaluator, deterministic and independent of machine load) and reports speedup = anchor instructions / method instructions on the same windows, so the measured speedup is the same kind of quantity but need not equal 5.3 (the paper's evolved code and frontier code are unreleased and are reconstructed here). Balancedness is the paper's imbalance factor (mean GPU load / max GPU load on the next window), on the paper's scale (0.66). Each scored rebalance covers 29 MoE layers (the paper's 58 layers are split into visible and held-out halves) and 20 rebalance pairs per slice (the trace's four time blocks are split between the visible and the hidden slice).

speedup_vs_frontier_reference.description: Mean rebalance instructions of the frozen frontier-reference policy divided by the method's mean rebalance instructions, both measured by the evaluator (hardware instruction counter on the policy process) on the same rebalance pairs. 0 if the run failed (invalid output or placement, crash, instruction cap, or balance constraint).

balancedness.description: Paper's imbalance factor on the next window: sum over layers of mean GPU load divided by sum over layers of max GPU load, averaged over all rebalance pairs. Must stay within 0.005 of the frontier reference or the run fails. 0 if the run failed.

mean_rebalance_instructions.description: Unscored diagnostic: mean retired user-space CPU instructions per rebalance, measured by the evaluator's hardware counter on the policy process tree from sending the window to receiving the placement.

balance_change_vs_frontier_reference.description: Unscored diagnostic: measured balancedness minus the frontier reference's on the same windows (shown even for failed runs).

valid_fraction.description: Unscored diagnostic: fraction of rebalance pairs that returned a valid placement before the run stopped.

run_failed.description: Unscored diagnostic: 1 if the run failed (reason recorded under _failures in the score file).

diagnostic_cpu_ms_per_rebalance.description: Unscored, host-dependent: CPU time of the measured rebalance (software task clock), kept only to cross-check the instruction count.

num_rebalances.description: Unscored: number of rebalance pairs scored per method.

reported_runtime_ms.description: Paper-reported wall-clock rebalance time, kept for context only; not emitted or scored.
